empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write a skill from scratch, or import one from a markdown file or a zip archive.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.importedNotice: This skill was written by someone else. Its body becomes instructions inside the prompt of every agent that uses it — read it before you enable it.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface: write it as a directive that says when to apply the skill and what to do, e.g. “Use when reviewing tests: flag every branch no test reaches.”
form.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe how to apply the rule…
form.required: Name, description and body are required.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or a zip archive. You review it before anything is saved.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.
import.wrongType: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
import.readFailed: The file could not be read.
import.trustBody: An imported skill is another person's text placed in your agent's prompt. It can steer the model — read it fully before you save it. Nothing in the file is run.
import.ignoredHint: Only the skill's text is used. These files were left out and are never run.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? Agents that use it lose it. This cannot be undone.

config.title: Configuration
config.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

stats.none: No agent has this skill switched on.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body, so a review run can be traced to the exact text it used.
versions.dirtyNote: Save or discard your unsaved changes on the Config tab before restoring a version.
versions.diffHint: What restoring v{version} would change: green lines come back, red lines go away.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? Its text is saved again as a new version; nothing is deleted.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.
